execution.operation: Inspect all selected milestone UAT and verification records. Distinguish failed, blocked, untested and passed cases; produce an actionable list with evidence paths, not an automatic pass.

entries.name: gsd:autonomous
entries.description: Run all remaining phases autonomously — discuss→plan→execute per phase

execution.operation: Continue the ready project phases in dependency order within the current task. Stop for required input, explicit approvals or real blockers. Persist continuation context; do not create a background scheduler or bypass permissions.

entries.name: gsd:check-todos
entries.description: List pending todos and select one to work on

execution.operation: List pending todos and context, then work only on the selected or clearly requested item. Move an item to completed only after its acceptance condition is met.

entries.name: gsd:cleanup
entries.description: Archive accumulated phase directories from completed milestones

execution.operation: Inventory completed milestone/phase artifacts and propose an archive plan. Check references and preserve history. Archive only authorized paths; never recursively delete unknown state.

entries.name: gsd:complete-milestone
entries.description: Archive completed milestone and prepare for next version

execution.operation: Run the milestone audit, reconcile requirement coverage and verification, and report unresolved failures. Archive the milestone's roadmap and requirements with a summary only after real acceptance; Git release/tag/push is a separate explicit action.

entries.name: gsd:debug
entries.description: Systematic debugging with persistent state across context resets

execution.operation: Record a debug session with symptoms, reproduction, competing evidence and one testable root-cause hypothesis. Observe a failing test, implement the smallest fix, verify and close only the resolved incident.

entries.name: gsd:discuss-phase
entries.description: Gather phase context through adaptive questioning before planning. Use --auto to skip interactive questions (Claude picks recommended defaults).

execution.operation: Read the phase goal and existing context. Resolve only implementation gray areas that affect scope or acceptance. Write CONTEXT.md with decisions, deferred ideas and constraints; do not redesign unrelated phases.

entries.name: gsd:do
entries.description: Route freeform text to the right GSD command automatically

execution.operation: Resolve the user's intent to the correct GSD operation using the current project state, then execute it. Ask only if the choice materially changes scope, destructive effects or acceptance.

entries.name: gsd:execute-phase
entries.description: Execute all plans in a phase with wave-based parallelization

execution.operation: Read all phase plans, validate their dependencies and execution gates, then implement in wave order. Use sequential execution unless delegation is authorized. Record actual tests and deviations in per-plan SUMMARY.md and verify the phase goal before updating progress.

entries.name: gsd:fast
entries.description: Execute a trivial task inline — no subagents, no planning overhead

execution.operation: Execute the bounded request directly using existing project context and targeted verification. Keep essential approval and safety gates; skip optional process artifacts only when they do not carry necessary continuation state.

entries.name: gsd:forensics
entries.description: Post-mortem investigation for failed GSD workflows — analyzes git history, artifacts, and state to diagnose what went wrong

execution.operation: Inspect the actual Git history, diffs, logs and planning records for the incident. Reconstruct a sourced timeline and distinguish observation from inference; do not alter evidence.

entries.name: gsd:health
entries.description: Diagnose planning directory health and optionally repair issues

execution.operation: Validate .planning structure, phase IDs, reference targets, requirement traceability, summaries versus plans, config syntax and stale state. Report precise inconsistencies before making narrowly authorized repairs.

entries.name: gsd:help
entries.description: Show available GSD commands and usage guide

execution.operation: Explain the relevant native GSD operations and show ordinary prompt examples. They are catalog recipes, not guaranteed registered slash commands. Inspect project state before recommending the next operation.

entries.name: gsd:insert-phase
entries.description: Insert urgent work as decimal phase (e.g., 72.1) between existing phases

execution.operation: Insert a decimal-numbered future phase after the selected phase without rewriting completed history. Update dependency links, traceability and roadmap consistently; verify that existing IDs remain unambiguous.

entries.name: gsd:join-discord
entries.description: Join the GSD Discord community

execution.operation: Use the public community link from the original command only if the user requests it. Opening a community site does not authorize joining, posting or sharing project information.

entries.name: gsd:list-phase-assumptions
entries.description: Surface Claude's assumptions about a phase approach before planning

execution.operation: Inspect the selected phase, codebase and dependencies; list concrete implementation assumptions with evidence, confidence and consequence. Resolve decision-changing uncertainty before planning.

entries.name: gsd:list-workspaces
entries.description: List active GSD workspaces and their status

execution.operation: List only known/explicitly selected project workspaces and their Git worktree state using native project tools or git worktree list. Do not scan personal home directories.

entries.name: gsd:manager
entries.description: Interactive command center for managing multiple phases from one terminal

execution.operation: Coordinate the user's selected projects using actual task/project tools and bounded status snapshots. Never create new tasks, move checkouts or send prompts to other tasks without authorization for those actions.

entries.name: gsd:map-codebase
entries.description: Analyze codebase with parallel mapper agents to produce .planning/codebase/ documents

execution.operation: Read the repository without changing application code. Produce focused .planning/codebase documents for architecture, stack, conventions, integrations, testing and concerns with real file references; use parallel mappers only if authorized.

entries.name: gsd:milestone-summary
entries.description: Generate a comprehensive project summary from milestone artifacts for team onboarding and review

execution.operation: Summarize the selected milestone from its original goals, accepted scope, implemented changes, test evidence, unresolved gaps and shipped artifacts. Do not substitute commit counts for outcomes.

entries.name: gsd:new-milestone
entries.description: Start a new milestone cycle — update PROJECT.md and route to requirements

execution.operation: Read the completed milestone and current implementation, clarify new scope, produce updated PROJECT.md, scoped REQUIREMENTS.md and a dependent ROADMAP.md. Preserve archived history and unfinished work.

entries.name: gsd:new-project
entries.description: Initialize a new project with deep context gathering and PROJECT.md

execution.operation: Gather the real project brief, inspect brownfield code when present, clarify only missing decision-critical context, and create PROJECT.md, config.json, REQUIREMENTS.md, ROADMAP.md and STATE.md. Optional research must use actual sources. End with a concrete first phase, not fictional implementation.

entries.name: gsd:new-workspace
entries.description: Create an isolated workspace with repo copies and independent .planning/

execution.operation: Use an explicitly selected repository and the native worktree/project mechanism. Verify the returned checkout path and branch before work. Do not invent global workspace roots or copy uncommitted/private state.

entries.name: gsd:next
entries.description: Automatically advance to the next logical step in the GSD workflow

execution.operation: Inspect the project and choose the next valid action: resolve blocker, discuss missing decisions, plan unplanned scope, execute a valid plan, verify implementation or start the next milestone. Explain the evidence behind the choice and carry out the requested continuation.

entries.name: gsd:note
entries.description: Zero-friction idea capture. Append, list, or promote notes to todos.

execution.operation: Write the user's explicitly requested note to project-owned planning notes with its context and next action. Do not write private/global memory or silently edit source configuration.

entries.name: gsd:pause-work
entries.description: Create context handoff when pausing work mid-phase

execution.operation: Capture exact continuation context, pending changes, tests, blockers and next commands in an append-only checkpoint. Use a native pause/goal action only when separately available and requested; a checkpoint is not a background job.

entries.name: gsd:plan-milestone-gaps
entries.description: Create phases to close all gaps identified by milestone audit

execution.operation: Convert verified milestone audit gaps into the smallest dependent remediation phases. Preserve the original requirements and link each new phase to the gap and its acceptance evidence.

entries.name: gsd:plan-phase
entries.description: Create detailed phase plan (PLAN.md) with verification loop

execution.operation: Read goals, requirements, CONTEXT.md and relevant code; research unresolved technical choices. Write executable PLAN.md files with task ownership, dependency waves, files, test commands, checkpoints and must-have artifacts. Check goal coverage before execution.

entries.name: gsd:plant-seed
entries.description: Capture a forward-looking idea with trigger conditions — surfaces automatically at the right milestone

execution.operation: Capture a future idea with context, rationale and revisit condition in project-owned notes/backlog. Keep it out of active scope unless explicitly promoted.

entries.name: gsd:pr-branch
entries.description: Create a clean PR branch by filtering out .planning/ commits — ready for code review

execution.operation: Inspect Git history and propose a clean review branch excluding planning-only commits without losing application changes. Do not rewrite the active branch, discard uncommitted changes or push without authorization; verify the resulting diff if creation is requested.

entries.name: gsd:profile-user
entries.description: Generate developer behavioral profile and create Claude-discoverable artifacts

execution.operation: Analyze only task history the user explicitly supplied or authorized. Produce an evidence-scored developer profile with uncertainty; do not scan Claude sessions or modify global instructions automatically.

entries.name: gsd:progress
entries.description: Check project progress, show context, and route to next action (execute or plan)

execution.operation: Report recent verified work, current phase, plan versus summary counts, blockers, pending tasks and the next actionable step. Inspect actual verification evidence; inventory counts are not completion percentages.

entries.name: gsd:quick
entries.description: Execute a quick task with GSD guarantees (atomic commits, state tracking) but skip optional agents

execution.operation: Perform a small scoped task with a concrete plan, implementation and targeted verification. Keep a concise continuation/summary record and follow commit policy without invoking optional agents.

entries.name: reapply-patches
entries.description: Reapply local modifications after a GSD update

execution.operation: Inspect a known backup and the currently installed pack, compare changes, and reapply only user-owned modifications with a reviewed diff. Never overwrite new upstream changes or run an upstream installer as a shortcut.

entries.name: gsd:remove-phase
entries.description: Remove a future phase from roadmap and renumber subsequent phases

execution.operation: Show the exact future phase and affected dependency/requirement links. Refuse to erase completed history. After authorized removal or archiving, update all remaining references and verify numbering; do not use broad recursive deletion.

entries.name: gsd:remove-workspace
entries.description: Remove a GSD workspace and clean up worktrees

execution.operation: Inspect the explicitly named worktree for uncommitted/untracked files and active use. Preserve changes and require the applicable removal approval. Use native worktree removal; never compute a broad home-directory deletion.

entries.name: gsd:research-phase
entries.description: Research how to implement a phase (standalone - usually use /gsd:plan-phase instead)

execution.operation: Investigate only the selected phase's implementation choices against repository evidence and current primary documentation. Write RESEARCH.md with source-backed recommendations, tradeoffs, risks and unresolved questions.

entries.name: gsd:resume-work
entries.description: Resume work from previous session with full context restoration

execution.operation: Inspect current planning state, the latest checkpoint and actual Git changes. Reconcile drift since the checkpoint and continue the exact next unfinished action without resetting or replaying completed work.

entries.name: gsd:review-backlog
entries.description: Review and promote backlog items to active milestone

execution.operation: Review backlog relevance, acceptance criteria and dependencies against current goals. Recommend priorities; promote selected items into future scope without silently replacing active commitments.

entries.name: gsd:review
entries.description: Request cross-AI peer review of phase plans from external AI CLIs

execution.operation: Review selected plans against requirements, dependency order, concrete tests and implementation feasibility. Independent/cross-provider review is optional and requires available authorized tools; label a single-agent review honestly.

entries.name: gsd:session-report
entries.description: Generate a session report with token usage estimates, work summary, and outcomes

execution.operation: Summarize work and verification from the current task and Git evidence. Use actual usage telemetry when available; never invent token counts, elapsed work or completed actions.

entries.name: gsd:set-profile
entries.description: Switch model profile for GSD agents (quality/balanced/budget/inherit)

execution.operation: Inspect supported Codex host settings. Default to inheriting the current model/reasoning. A planning preference named quality/balanced/budget is not a runtime model change; use a supported explicit configuration action or explain that boundary without guessing IDs.

entries.name: gsd:settings
entries.description: Configure GSD workflow toggles and model profile

execution.operation: Inspect and edit only selected project workflow preferences in .planning/config.json. Preserve unknown fields. Do not enable agents, change host permissions, authorize providers or alter global Codex configuration as a side effect.

entries.name: gsd:ship
entries.description: Create PR, run review, and prepare for merge after verification passes

execution.operation: Verify scope, clean/unrelated changes, type checks/build/tests and review findings. Create or update the explicitly requested PR using native GitHub/CLI tools, inspect its actual diff and status, and attach it when the host supports attachments. Do not merge or deploy implicitly.

entries.name: gsd:stats
entries.description: Display project statistics — phases, plans, requirements, git metrics, and timeline

execution.operation: Compute project statistics from existing planning files and Git. Distinguish phase/plan counts, implementation evidence and runtime usage; missing metrics remain unavailable rather than zero.

entries.name: gsd:thread
entries.description: Manage persistent context threads for cross-session work

execution.operation: Manage project-owned context notes for continuation. For actual Codex task creation, rename, reading or messages, use native task tools only when that task action is explicitly requested; do not manipulate session files.

entries.name: gsd:ui-phase
entries.description: Generate UI design contract (UI-SPEC.md) for frontend phases

execution.operation: Inspect the existing design system and selected phase requirements. Write UI-SPEC.md covering layout, interaction states, typography, color, accessibility, responsive behavior and concrete acceptance conditions without inventing assets.

entries.name: gsd:ui-review
entries.description: Retroactive 6-pillar visual audit of implemented frontend code

execution.operation: Inspect rendered UI and source against UI-SPEC.md, including hierarchy, states, responsiveness, contrast, keyboard behavior and content. Capture observable findings with severity and evidence; do not claim visual inspection from source alone.

entries.name: gsd:update
entries.description: Update GSD to latest version with changelog display

execution.operation: Check the public Codex pack release and compatibility notes. Review source pin/license/privacy changes before an additive installer update; preserve user-owned files and rollback state. Do not run the Claude/GSD updater against Codex.

entries.name: gsd:validate-phase
entries.description: Retroactively audit and fill Nyquist validation gaps for a completed phase

execution.operation: Compare the selected phase's requirements and must-haves to existing automated and manual verification. Add missing tests only within scope, run them, and update the verification report with actual outcomes and remaining manual checks.

entries.name: gsd:verify-work
entries.description: Validate built features through conversational UAT

execution.operation: Turn implemented phase goals into user-observable acceptance cases. Run applicable local/E2E checks, collect user-only observations when necessary, record passed/failed/blocked cases and diagnose failures before declaring acceptance.

entries.name: workstreams
